categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Seeyon Internet Software Corp. primarily operates in enterprise-level management software and services, focusing on collaborative office and collaborative operation management. Its product portfolio includes AI-driven collaborative management platforms and solutions for enterprises and government organizations, covering large, medium, and small-sized clients with products like A9, A8, A6 for enterprises and G9, G6 for government. The company also offers HR SaaS services, aviation and low-altitude economy solutions, and overseas digital services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and low-code development platforms to build integrated collaborative operation platforms (AI-COP). It develops proprietary collaborative technology platforms (COP-V5 and COP-V8) featuring cloud-native architecture, microservices, multi-tenant physical database isolation, AI agent customization, and workflow automation. The company continuously innovates in AI integration, intelligent workflow, and secure, scalable platform capabilities, including AI-native applications and intelligent contract management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises (central and provincial level), medium and large enterprises in manufacturing, finance, education, healthcare, and government agencies. The company serves over 50,000 enterprise and government clients across various industries such as energy, telecommunications, logistics, and retail. It also targets overseas markets including Hong Kong, Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa, serving local governments and multinational corporations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive coverage across Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Western China regions. It has expanded its footprint internationally in Hong Kong, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, and Latin America, establishing overseas delivery centers and strategic partnerships to support global clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Seeyon Internet Software Corp. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and IT services supply chain, focusing on software development, platform provision, and integrated digital solutions delivery to enterprise and government end-users. It acts as a solution provider and service integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer or upstream technology supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven digital transformation, focusing on upgrading its AI-COP platform with AI agent technology, low-code development, and cloud-native architecture. It invests heavily in R&D (over 25% of revenue) to enhance platform scalability, security, and intelligent automation. Strategic initiatives include expanding AI applications in collaborative workflows, intelligent contract management, HR SaaS, aviation analytics, and government digital services, alongside deepening ecosystem partnerships with Huawei, DingTalk, and others.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software product sales, including licenses for collaborative management software suites, and recurring technical services such as maintenance, implementation, and cloud-based SaaS subscriptions. The company also earns revenue from channel sales via distributors and direct sales to large enterprise and government clients. Additional income streams include investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider in the collaborative management software and services sector, with a strong market presence in central and provincial state-owned enterprises and government agencies. It competes with other enterprise software vendors focusing on digital transformation and AI integration. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary AI-COP platforms, comprehensive product suites for various enterprise sizes, and a robust ecosystem of technology and service partners.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 846.5 million, a decline of 18.97% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 235.6 million. Despite revenue contraction, R&D investment remains high at over 25% of revenue. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 1.61 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.05 billion. It is in a transformation phase focusing on sustainable growth through AI and platform upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing Seeyon Internet Software Corp. differentiates itself by providing an integrated AI-driven collaborative operation platform that combines workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and secure multi-tenant architecture tailored for large and complex organizations. Its low-code development environment reduces application development barriers, enabling rapid customization and deployment. The company emphasizes security compliance, especially in trusted computing environments (信创), and offers a comprehensive ecosystem with strategic partners to deliver end-to-end digital transformation solutions.
